elements.description:
Chunking, top-k, a score threshold, keyword ↔ vector balance, reranking, metadata filters and how many chunks go
into context – with the pipeline they make and the cost and latency the app reports.

properties.name: value
properties.default: { chunkSize: 512, chunkOverlap: 64, topK: 40, threshold: 0.3, hybrid: 0.7, rerank: true, rerankModel: "", topN: 8, filters: [] }
properties.description: The config. Changed by the user unless a tc-value-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: filterFields
properties.description: The metadata fields filters can test; without any, a filter's field is typed in

properties.name: rerankModels
properties.description: The reranking models to offer; without any, Rerank is a switch only

properties.name: indexed
properties.description: The chunking the sources are indexed with now – a different size or overlap says the sources will be re-indexed

properties.name: estimate
properties.description: Per-query cost and latency from the app, shown on the pipeline and at the foot; unset shows none

properties.name: stage
properties.description: The stage whose settings show under the pipeline: "retrieve", "filter", "rerank" or "context"

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading; also names the group

properties.name: description
properties.description: A quieter line under the heading, e.g. which index this is

properties.name: flat
properties.description: Drops the tray and the card, for settings inside another card

properties.name: name
properties.description: Submitted with the form: the config as JSON

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Turns every control off and leaves the config out of the form; a disabled fieldset does the same

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-value-change
events.description: The config changed ({ value: RetrievalSettingsValue }); cancelable – prevent it to control `value`

events.name: tc-stage-change
events.description: A stage of the pipeline was opened for editing ({ stage }: RetrievalStageChange); cancelable

functions.name: retrievalSettingsProblem
functions.description: The first problem with a config, if any: [message, the part it's about]

props.name: title
props.description: Shown at the top; names the group

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The config to start with when uncontrolled

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the whole config after every change

props.name: stage
props.description: The stage whose settings show – controlled when given

props.name: onStageChange
props.description: A stage was opened for editing
